$comment: THE RATCHET (contract/live_conformance.py, the third contract leg). Every LIVE wire message the harness captures is classified to a key: an event is `event:<name>`, an rsp is `rsp:<originating-command>`, and a non-envelope frame is its bare `type` (`log`, `instances`, `binary`). A key that a schema describes (events with type/name consts, or an rsp command in live-wire-map.json) is VALIDATED. A key that no schema describes is checked HERE: on the list -> counted and reported as a known-undescribed message; NOT on the list -> the test FAILS ('a new unschema'd wire message shipped — add a schema, or add it here with a reason'). That is the ratchet: a new message type can never reach the wire silently undescribed. Entries were SEEDED from the messages a representative live session actually produced (see the harness docstring); each carries why it has no per-message schema yet. NOTE: every rsp is additionally validated against the generic rsp.schema.json envelope, so an allowlisted rsp is still envelope-checked — the allowlist only means its per-COMMAND data shape is not yet modelled.

rsp:ping.reason: liveness probe; data is {pong:true}. Trivial, envelope-checked against rsp.schema.json.

rsp:open_project.reason: project open reply (plugin+instance lists). Large, plugin-shaped data; not yet modelled.

rsp:compile_and_load.reason: script compile reply {dll,diagnostics,...}. Not yet modelled.

rsp:set_instance_def.reason: def-set ack; echoes nothing structured. Envelope-checked.

rsp:list_instances.reason: cmd ack; the real payload arrives on the separate `instances` message channel.

rsp:run.reason: cmd:run reply {run_id,ms,verdict?}. Run identity/verdict; the run OUTCOME is modelled by the run_result event, not this ack.

log.reason: human-readable log line (compile output, diagnostics). Free-text channel, not a structured contract.

instances.reason: instances snapshot pushed on its own top-level type in response to list_instances. Recipe-shaped; not yet modelled.

event:status.reason: best-effort sticky-status accelerator (source -> text). The authoritative snapshot is the `status` cmd rsp; the event is a live hint.

event:compile_started.reason: progress notification fired when a script/plugin compile begins ({path}). A UI spinner cue, not a structured result; the outcome is compile_finished + the compile_and_load rsp.

event:compile_finished.reason: progress notification fired when a compile ends ({path, ok}). The authoritative compile result (dll, diagnostics) is the compile_and_load rsp.

event:run_started.reason: progress notification fired when an inspect run begins ({run_id}). The run OUTCOME/timing are the run_result + run_finished events (both schema'd).
